name: DialogPortalPrimitive
description: Portal container that renders dialog content outside the normal DOM hierarchy. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: container
type: HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | React.RefObject<HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | null> | null
props.description: A parent element to render the portal element into.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether to keep the portal mounted in the DOM while the popup is hidden.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
Accepts a ReactElement or a function that returns the element to render.
